description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source project and handles the installation process, including creating or updating the database schema, creating user accounts, writing configuration files, and performing data migrations. It manages the setup workflow for initializing or upgrading the TestLink database environment.

classes.name: database
classes.description: A class for managing database connections and executing SQL queries within the installation process.

classes.name: SqlParser
classes.description: A class for parsing and processing SQL script files during database schema setup and migration.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for retrieving database table information in the TestLink environment.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: A class extending tlObject with database management capabilities, such as retrieving view and table metadata.

methods.name: check_db_loaded_extension
methods.description: Checks for required database extensions or dependencies.

methods.name: close_html_and_exit
methods.description: Outputs the closing HTML and terminates script execution.

methods.name: create_user_for_db
methods.description: Creates or ensures the existence of a database user with proper permissions.

methods.name: write_config_db
methods.description: Generates and writes the database configuration PHP file.

methods.name: getDirSqlFiles
methods.description: Retrieves SQL files from specified directories for schema or data setup.

methods.name: manual_operations
methods.description: Displays manual operations instructions necessary for completing setup.

methods.name: important_reminder
methods.description: Outputs important notices to the user regarding manual steps.

methods.name: drop_views
methods.description: Drops all existing database views, used during reinstallation.

methods.name: drop_tables
methods.description: Drops all existing database tables, used during reinstallation.
